# muxt documentation with no argument prints the path of every embedded file

muxt documentation
stdout '^docs/README\.md$'
stdout '^docs/reference/cli\.md$'
stdout '^docs/examples/simple/main\.go$'
! stdout ' — '

muxt documentation docs/reference/template-names.md
stdout '^# Template Name Syntax$'

muxt documentation reference/template-names.md
stdout '^# Template Name Syntax$'

muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/generate.md
stdout '^# muxt generate'

muxt help documentation
stdout 'documentation'

muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/check.md
stdout '^# muxt check'

muxt documentation docs/README.md
stdout '^# Muxt Documentation$'

muxt documentation docs/examples/simple/main.go
stdout '^docs/examples/simple/main\.go$'
stdout '^```go$'
stdout '^package main$'

muxt documentation docs/how-to
stdout '^docs/how-to/template-functions\.md$'
! stdout '^docs/reference/'

! muxt documentation docs/reference/clii.md
stderr 'did you mean: docs/reference/cli\.md'

! muxt documentation template-names
stderr 'did you mean: docs/reference/template-names\.md'
